title: Grateful Dead Live at RFK Stadium on 1973-06-10
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi 550 > Lexicon Alpha > Samplitude > CD-Tag > FLAC
source: FOB > Single-point Mic > Sonny TC 110 > MAC

ai_review.summary: An extraordinary audience recording that captures the Wall‑of‑Sound’s atmosphere with excellent fidelity, featuring standout performances of Morning Dew, Dark Star and other classics.
ai_review.review: The Monte‑taped FOB audience tape is hailed as a benchmark for RFK Stadium shows – crisp, spacious and full of the echoing “wall‑of‑sound” ambience that board mixes can’t reproduce.  The music shines too, with an inspired Jerry‑Phil interplay, soaring Dark Star, powerful Morning Dew, and memorable renditions of Here Comes Sunshine, Eyes of the World, Looks Like Rain and Playing In The Band.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 4‑5 stars, consistently praising both the sonic capture and the musical performance; only minor criticisms appear.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded with a single‑point stereo mic from an in‑field FOB spot; reviewers note crystal‑clear Wall‑of‑Sound capture, pleasant stadium echo and “sound candy”, with only occasional clipping, chatter or audience noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A marathon 4‑hour+ set that flows naturally through deep jams and tight songs; the stadium atmosphere, fireworks and crowd energy are woven into a memorable musical journey.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his tone and seamless interplay with Phil; reviewers call his guitar work “stellar” and miss him dearly.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as being on top of his game, delivering bass‑centric solos that dominate the middle sections of Dark Star and Playing In The Band.
